create_CommandlineFlag: create a CommandlineFlag named tuple with a name, flag string, and description
create_Commandline_space: create a Commandline space from a list of CommandlineFlag instances with a space name
to_string_commandline: convert a list of integer values to a space-separated commandline flag string
from_string_commandline: parse a commandline flag string into a list of integer action values
sample_Commandline: sample a random integer action value from the Commandline space
